title: Important Notice - schedule for CBT - Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality Qualification

source.name: Medical Services Recruitment Board (MRB), Tamil Nadu

text:
KEY LINES:
NOTIFICATION NO: 22/MRB/2025 DATE: 10.01.2026
of Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality Qualification- 2025 vide

GOVERNMENT OF TAMIL NADU

NOTIFICATION NO: 22/MRB/2025 DATE: 10.01.2026
NOTICE
Medical Services Recruitment Board had published Notification for the Post
of Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality Qualification- 2025 vide
NOTIFICATION NO: 22/MRB/2025 Dated: 18.12.2025. The Computer Based
Test for the Post of Assistant Surgeon (General) with Speciality
Qualification-2025 is scheduled to be held on 25th January 2026 (Sunday)
in the afternoon session.
Timing:
Tamil Eligibility Test : 02.00 PM to 03.00PM
Subject Paper : 03.15 PM to 05.15PM
